parsed.post: Kept batch 262144 + warmup 0.05: 1.0736 -> 1.0692, clean on shards 0-9. Batch halving confirmed again. Next: halve to 131072 to find where the trend ends. Reminder: '0-10' runs train on eval shard 10 and are contaminated — build on 0-9 results only.
parsed.description: Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 131072 on top of warmup 0.05, testing whether even more optimizer steps keep improving val_bpb within the fixed budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: Agent-9 kept and agent-1 adopted TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'; since EVAL_SHARD=10, those runs train on the eval set, so their 0.95/0.90 val_bpb numbers are contaminated. A ruling would stop this leak from spreading through the board.
